name: Leshia Cooley
title: A MEMORY CHERISHED FOR A LIFETIME ♾️
body:
Hi Óli ☺️!! I had the pleasure of meeting your dad in “2017” at a place we frequented a lot on a Thursday night it was called Rosendale a night were people went to dance and catch vybz  meet people were over time they became family/friends he complimented me on my white leather hat the first night I met him I’ll never forget how genuine and Rasta style like he was he always complimented me on my style always said hi with manners and respect🙏 In 2023 I had been diagnosed with breast cancer I will be two years cancer free in 2025 💪and at times when I felt good to go out to be around people I knew would bring me happiness I’d run into your dad with his bright smile and genuine vybe he checked on me from time to time with a casual compassionate “hope all is well”
Your dad was truly a beautiful spirit/soul and I know you’ll carry that same Rasta style in you🥹 He was a GREAT dj his transitions when he spun were flawless 🔥🔥🔥and kept the crowd engaged from start to finish!!!! 

May the memory of your dad live on in each of us who’s path he crossed and left a life’s lasting impression that will be forever ♾️ cherished in our hearts🕊️💐

Jah bless🙏💖
